gloss: to smash, to crush, to break

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {砕|くだ}いていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to smash, to crush, to break into pieces
definitions.explanation: To break something hard into smaller fragments.

definitions.gloss: to simplify, to explain in simple terms
definitions.explanation: To make complex information easier to understand.

notes:
{砕|くだ}く means to smash or crush hard objects into smaller pieces.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)
- Pair: ⟦{砕|くだ}ける→砕ける：04667_kudakeru⟧ (intransitive - to be broken)
- Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{砕|くだ}く

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{氷|こおり}→氷：02753_koori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{砕|くだ}く (to crush ice)
- ⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{砕|くだ}く (to work very hard, lit: to crush one's bones)
- {砕|くだ}いて⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to explain in simple terms)
- ⟦{砕|くだ}けた→砕ける：04667_kudakeru⟧⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧ (casual expression)
